sentences.en: In the earliest mosque at old Delhi, they adopted the piers and bracketed capitals of the Jaina builders, whom they probably employed to build their mosque.
sentences.vi: Trong nhà thờ Hồi giáo sớm nhất ở Delhi cũ, họ đã thông qua các cầu tàu và thủ đô của những người xây dựng Jaina, những người mà họ có lẽ đã thuê để xây dựng nhà thờ Hồi giáo của họ.

sentences.en: In the succeeding paragraph the bracketed figures indicate the distance in miles above London Bridge.

sentences.en: The bridges in order above London Bridge are as follows, railway-bridges being bracketed - Southwark, (Cannon Street), (Blackfriars), Blackfriars, Waterloo, (Hungerford - with a footway), Westminster, Lambeth, Vauxhall, (Grosvenor), Victoria, Albert, Battersea, (Battersea), Wandsworth, (Putney), Putney and Hammersmith.
sentences.vi: Các cây cầu theo thứ tự phía trên Cầu Luân Đôn như sau, cầu đường sắt được nối liền - Southwark, (Cannon Street), (Blackfriars), Blackfriars, Waterloo, (Hungerford - với một lối đi bộ), Westminster, Lambeth, Vauxhall, (Grosvenor), Victoria, Albert, Battersea, (Battersea), Wandsworth, (Putney), Putney và Hammersmith.

sentences.en: The new view of faith is bracketed with the old, and practically neutralized by it; as was already the case in Melanchthon's theological definitions in the 1552-1553 edition of Loci Communes, also printed in other works by him.

sentences.en: And this food is called by us Eucharistia, and of it none may partake save those who believe our teachings to be true and have been washed in the bath which is for remission of sin and rebirth, and who so live as We should probably omit the words bracketed.

sentences.en: Mrs. Fawcett's only child, Miss Philippa Garrett Fawcett, had a distinguished career at Newnham College, Cambridge, where in 1890 she was bracketed equal to senior wrangler.
